description_en: Queries the details of a call task and call conversation information

parameters.help_en: The task detail ID. View the task detail ID in the upper-left corner of the Call Task Management > Details > Execution Records > Completed > Call Details console, or retrieve it by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926853.html operation
